## Goal

Terminal output agents can verify without vision and humans see exactly: one frame model, an owned renderer, recordings and a ratatui capture crate.

## Owned requirements

Close each with the check below, through the real public interface (README §3).

| ID | Requirement | Route | Concrete check |
|---|---|---|---|
| TM-01 | A normalized terminal frame model and owned renderer that is pixel-consistent across modes on a fidelity fixture suite (box drawing, 256 and true colour, CJK, emoji ZWJ, combining marks) | M, B | Fidelity fixture suite (box drawing, 256 and true color, CJK, emoji ZWJ, combining marks, wrap, cursor, alt screen) renders consistently across modes within threshold |
| TM-03 | Recorded mode: asciicast v3 playback with scrubbing and markers | B | asciicast v3 playback with scrub and markers (browser) |
| TM-06 | `term dump` (text, cells, ANSI) and terminal lint for agents | M | `term dump` text, cells and ANSI goldens; lint flags misaligned borders, overflow and width disagreements on fixtures |

## Scope

From [WORK_PACKAGES.md](../WORK_PACKAGES.md):

- frame schemas;
- `@xterm/headless` replay with Unicode 11 widths;
- `<TerminalGrid>` with a bundled font and procedural glyphs;
- recorded mode with scrubbing and markers;
- the `mostra-term-capture` crate (TestBackend buffer and scripted keys to frames);
- `term dump` and terminal lint.

Design detail for this package:

- Frame schemas in `@mostra/protocol`, shared with the Rust crate.
- `@xterm/headless` replay with Unicode 11; `<TerminalGrid>` with bundled font and procedural glyphs.
- Recorded mode with scrub and markers; `term dump` and terminal lint.
- `mostra-term-capture` crate.

## Acceptance evidence

the fidelity fixture suite (the prototype's nine fixtures plus 256-color and truecolor grids) renders pixel-consistently across browsers within the stated threshold; the capture crate produces frames for scripted keys; dump goldens. (The zero-difference proof against WASM mode is TM-05, owned by WP-23.)

Also: `pnpm check` green, diff reviewed, the progress report's evidence table complete for every owned requirement (README §3), the evidence matrix regenerated, docs and AGENTS.md current, and the report finalized after acceptance (README §4).

## Risks and notes

- ZWJ, flags and VS16 emoji disagree across engines (prototype): lint them.

## Handoff

WP-23 adds live sessions and compares frames across modes.
